# Section 010: The 4Cs of Cloud Native Security

Makes the reader able to name the four layers of cloud native security (Cloud, Cluster, Container and Code), place a control or a weakness on the right layer, and reason about how a failure at one layer changes the risk at the next. It then covers defense in depth: preventive, detective and corrective controls.

**Curriculum item covered:** The 4Cs of Cloud Native Security (KCSA, Overview of Cloud Native Security)

---

## What You Will Master

- Identify the asset and the responsibility at each of the four security layers
- Explain how a failure in an outer layer can undermine the controls of an inner layer
- Read a pod specification and name which fields belong to the cluster layer and which to the container layer
- Show with kubectl how much a service account token allows, and remove the excess
- Explain what the platform can and cannot control when the application code is vulnerable
- Classify a control as preventive, detective or corrective
- Enforce a Pod Security level on a namespace and explain why it leaves running pods alone
- Use the audit and warn modes to find violations without blocking them
- Contain an unmanaged pod and roll back a failed Deployment change

---

## The Learning Path

### 1. Security Across Cloud, Cluster, Container And Code
*   **Module Reader:** **[Module 1: Security Across Cloud, Cluster, Container And Code](./module-01/course.md)**
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-010/module-01/playground` — kind cluster, no extra tools. Namespaces `starfleet` and `outpost` with the Starfleet workloads, a `legacy-agent` pod on a service account bound to `cluster-admin`, and a privileged `privileged-debug` pod that mounts the node directory `/etc`.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS041.git -c sections/section-010/module-01/playground
    ```
*   **Graded lab:** `sections/section-010/module-01/labs/lab-01`

### 2. Defense In Depth: Preventive, Detective And Corrective Controls
*   **Module Reader:** **[Module 2: Defense In Depth: Preventive, Detective And Corrective Controls](./module-02/course.md)**
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-010/module-02/playground` — kind cluster, no extra tools. The Starfleet workloads, no Pod Security labels, and an unmanaged privileged pod `intruder` in `outpost`.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS041.git -c sections/section-010/module-02/playground
    ```
*   **Graded lab:** `sections/section-010/module-02/labs/lab-01`

### Section Capstone Challenge
*   **Comprehensive Challenge:** The 4Cs of Cloud Native Security Capstone — `sections/section-010/capstone/labs/lab-01`
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS041.git -c sections/section-010/capstone/labs/lab-01
    astrona submit -c .
    ```
*   **Hands-on Objective:** The namespace `relay` must be made safe. The reader removes a `cluster-admin` binding, stops a token from being mounted, hardens a privileged Deployment to the restricted settings, enforces the restricted Pod Security level and removes an unmanaged pod.

All labs and playgrounds are UNTESTED: built and checked statically only.
